provider_semantics.expiry: A provider credential with expires_at <= now is treated as expired. Attestations issued by an expired provider are no longer valid: is_attestation_valid returns false and is_allowed treats the attested address as not allowed. Expiration is detected lazily on read and emits provider_expired (once per provider) plus attestation_invalidated for each affected attestation.
provider_semantics.revocation: revoke_provider marks a provider as withdrawn immediately. All attestations issued by a revoked provider become invalid regardless of their own expiry: is_attestation_valid returns false and is_allowed treats the attested address as not allowed. Revocation emits provider_revoked plus attestation_invalidated for each affected attestation and is irreversible.
provider_semantics.precedence: Revocation takes precedence over expiry; a revoked provider is never reported as merely expired.
